articleTitle: Analyzing Credit Card Defaulters: A Comparative Study Using Kohonen Maps, Neural Networks, and Decision Trees
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: The text discusses the credit card debt crisis faced by credit card issuers in Taiwan, which has led to a decrease in consumer financial confidence and poses problems for both banks and cardholders. There is a study conducted using data on customers who took credit cards in order to identify the most important criteria for non-payers. The study aims to predict loan repayment ability using a neural network and selecting the most significant factors. The literature review highlights the use of neural networks in determining non-payers and the potential for creating systems to warn credit card owners about risk behavior. The methodology involves data processing using the Kohonen map, a type of neural network that uses unsupervised learning for visualization and clustering. Decision Trees and Neural Networks are also used in the analysis. Analysis using Kohonen maps did not provide the necessary information due to heterogeneous data in clusters. Analysis via a neural network resulted in a high error percentage of 17.6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and lacked accuracy in predicting average values. Analysis through the decision tree yielded a lower error percentage of 12.5% and identified repayment status in September and August as the most significant factors. An experiment was conducted by dividing factors into logical groups, resulting in a difference of 7% in error percentages for each group. The conclusion suggests that the decision tree method is the most suitable for this data model, with repayment status in September as the key factor in predicting defaulters.

articleTitle: Enhancing Video Storage Efficiency in the Cloud: Machine Learning-Driven Optimization Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Video storage optimization in the cloud is a critical research area with significant implications for efficient resource utilization, cost reduction, and improved user experiences. This research manuscript explores the application of machine learning techniques for video storage optimization in cloud-based environments. The objective is to develop innovative methods that leverage the power of machine learning algorithms to enhance the efficiency of video storage, enabling effective management, retrieval, and delivery of video content. The manuscript presents a comprehensive analysis of existing approaches, identifies their limitations, and proposes novel techniques to address the identified challenges. The research focuses on leveraging machine learning algorithms for video transcoding, content-aware caching, intelligent data placement, and adaptive streaming, among other areas. Experimental evaluations and performance comparisons are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed techniques. The findings show that the proposed CNN-based video transcoding technique achieved an average storage size reduction of 40%. The content-aware caching technique outperformed baseline methods with an average cache hit rate of 75%. The RL-based intelligent data placement technique achieved an average data popularity of 85%. Lastly, the RL-based adaptive streaming technique obtained significantly higher user satisfaction ratings, with an average Mean Opinion Score (MOS) of 4.6 out of 5.

articleTitle: 3D Printing Failure Detection, A Machine Learning Extension Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Additive manufacturing is experiencing a surge in popularity, with affordable 3D printers utilizing Fused Deposition Modelling (FDM) technology becoming commonplace among hobbyists. While once a niche technology, these printers are now accessible at reduced costs. However, the quality and reliability of 3D-printed objects are susceptible to numerous variables, posing risks of harm, material wastage, and time loss in case of failures. Addressing this, the integration of computer vision and machine learning for failure detection is crucial. Existing 3D print failure datasets face limitations in detecting failures in diverse environments and lighting conditions. To overcome this, our proposed architecture framework enhances modularity within applications, enabling customization for machine learning models and datasets. This allows end-users to train the model with their specific printing environment dataset and seamlessly integrate it with currently available control software. Our architecture aims to bridge the gap between theoretical concepts and real-world applications, ultimately improving the overall reliability and effectiveness of 3D printing technology. In experimental trials, the detection model trained with a custom dataset demonstrated superior performance. Using the same printing configuration, the pretrained model achieved 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> stringing test failure detection, 80% for boats, 42.86% for name plates, and 12.5% for action figures. With additional custom data, detection rates improved to 100% for stringing tests, 90% for boats, 71.43% for name plates, and 62.5% for action figures.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Wireless Network Using Penetration Testing Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: The security of wireless network infrastructure needs to be tested regularly using the Penetration testing method. This research explores Deauthentication, fluxion, Man- In-The-Middle, Denial-of-Service (DoS), and WEP/WPA injection attacks on wireless networks. The results showed the importance of effective protection to prevent these attacks. Penetration testing methods successfully identified vulnerabilities in the network infrastructure and evaluated implemented security measures. Recommendations included the use of strong encryption protocols, regular software updates, effective firewall settings, and increased user awareness of security practices. This research contributes to improving wireless network security and protecting sensitive information.

articleTitle: An Improved Dual Authentication Techniques for Secure Data Transmission in VANETs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Research related to user authentication techniques in vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs) has received significant attention in the last decade. However, its security and privacy still become a central issue that is widely open to discussion. In 2016, Vijayakumar et al. published dual authentication and key management techniques for secure data transmission in VANETs. The scheme aims to provide a high level of security on the vehicle side to prevent unauthorized vehicles from entering the VANETs effectively. It relies on the fingerprint and hashes code HC for the authentication process. The authors claimed that the mechanism could withstand the replaying attack by appending it with an updated timestamp and the packet's transmission. However, this paper shows that their scheme suffered a denial of service (DoS) attack due to misplaced timestamps. So, we propose an improvement of their scheme to withstand the attacks.

articleTitle: Enhancing Anomaly Classification Over Log Files through Topic Modeling and Ensemble Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Log files play a vital role in monitoring system changes, and their usage is rapidly increasing in cloud computing. To effectively address this challenge, text processing is an essential step in extracting information from unstructured text data, specifically log files, and transforming it into identifiable patterns using specific methods. Given the brevity of most log file text, this study focuses on the application of short text topic modeling and ensemble methods to classify log files andextract meaningful insights. The findings demonstrate that anomaly detection using short-text topic modeling and ensemble methods surpasses the benchmark method of Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling. Notably, the classification approach utilizing GSDMM,in combination with experiments involving XGBoost, achieves the highest performance when compared to other ensemble methods such as Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, andAdaBoost. To further optimize the performance of the XGBoost method in anomaly detection classification, hyperparameter tuning is conducted using Optuna. This approach effectively identifies the most optimal hyperparameters for XGBoost, leading to enhanced performance. Overall, this research illustrates that the utilization of short text topic modeling and ensemble methods, along with hyperparameter optimization, significantly improves the accuracy and effectiveness of anomaly detection in log file classification.

articleTitle: A Systematic Literature Review:Virtual Reality's in Decreasing Public Speaking Anxiety (PSA)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Virtual reality (VR), which is becoming increasingly popular these days, is used to treat several anxiety conditions. In this study, we present a method that uses virtual reality to cure public speaking anxiety. Public speaking anxiety (PSA) is a term used to describe a person's fear of speaking in front of a large audience or a big group of people. Our research will investigate whether VR technology can be used to treat PSA. We found publications on Google Scholar that were relevant to PSA and virtual reality using a keyword-based search technique, and we then conducted a thorough evaluation of the literature ⌝⌝⌝on those works. We found that the most of articles use samples that include more than two participants and use various PSA scale levels in virtual reality to treatment. Participants' anxiety levels decreased after each exposure, indicating that VR-based exposure could be used as an alternative treatment for anxiety related to public speaking

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Cloud Computing Using the NDLC Method Combined with Tunnel Link Split
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Today's education system increasingly incorporates information technology, such as the use of computers, the internet, and mobile devices. Utilization of this information technology can facilitate the teaching and learning process and increase the effectiveness, efficiency and productivity of users, both teachers, students and school administrators. However, given the growing number of users and the amount of data processed, school infrastructure often cannot meet these needs. The system development method will use the NDLC (Network Development Life Cycle) method which will be combined with the Tunnel Link Split to become a system that can be used remotely (remoting). The results of this research are that the results of designing and implementing cloud computing with the NDLC method combined with tunneling can be successful and used. Implementation is also carried out with additional monitoring using observium software and for access to the cloud using additional software, namely owncloud by obtaining an extended processor observium value of 99.90% (idle), detailed observium memory 69% (% of ram), swap storage observium 218.48kb/ s, observium ping response 86.4m/s, and observium traffic port wlo15.63m.

articleTitle: Securing a Watering System by a Fuzzy-Based Water Leakage Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Developing agricultural technology has improved the performance of several agricultural applications. With that, a significant improvement has been identified in different agricultural resource use optimization, such as water. Various works have been proposed to control water leakage in line with water use optimization. The previous works have not fully mitigated the water leakage problem, resulting in abuse. To address this problem, this work proposes a new method based on fuzzy logic to control the water flow in agricultural watering network pipes. To achieve our goal, we use water flow sensors integrated at similar distances over the water pipes. The simulation results showed the outperformance of our method over the state-of-the-art models in real-time detection of leakage in network pipes.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models for Data Traffic Anomaly Detection Systems in Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Cyberattacks can happen at any time and have many different goals. It might take the shape of ransomware, DOS attacks, or even malicious software. Its existence is undoubtedly a reason for concern since a continuous internet network might result in data flooding and a decline in the network's performance. In this paper, we try to develop an application of machine learning to analyze data traffic in the network. As we know, in a data traffic network, there are various types of data traffic in units of time. Analyzing each incoming network is very time-consuming, which makes it inefficient and ineffective so we try to develop an automated machine that can detect data traffic, or in other terms an Intrusion Detection System. By analyzing the types of attack variables, the KDD 1999 dataset provided one of the key components for constructing an IDS system. There are seven common types of supervised machine learning models. The machine learning model is designed to investigate the various types of attacks contained in the KDD 1999 dataset. The LGBM model is the most accurate of the seven models.

articleTitle: UMUX and UMUX-Lite as Usability Assessment for Smart Door Lock Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Smart Door Lock System is used to protect priceless and prevent unwanted access to a room. A usability evaluation is required to raise the system's usability level because it will help to decide how acceptable the system is. UMUX, UMUX-Lite, and SUS comparative ratings are used to gauge the usability level. The System Usability Score (SUS) has more questions than the UMUX and UMUX-Lite approaches. The general degree of acceptance of this system was deemed to be acceptable during the system's evaluation period. With an average UMUX score of 68,1, which is in the marginal category, the UMUX-LITe score is 77.3, which is categorized as acceptable, and the SUS comparison score is 73.0, which is categorized as acceptable.

articleTitle: Enhancing The User Interface and User Experience of SiKeren Presence Mobile Application With User Centered Design Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: SiKeren is a mobile-based application designed to facilitate attendance processes for civil servants within the scope of Jember District Government. Based on the initial evaluation, the SUS scores were found to be below the average parameter, scoring 60.9. Therefore, there is a potential for continuous enhancement in the SiKeren application. This is further supported by observations and in-depth interviews indicating shortcomings in the User Interface and User Experience (UI/UX) aspects of the SiKeren application. Given these conditions, this study aims to enhancing the UI/UX of SiKeren application to optimally meet user needs and preferences through redesigning the UI/UX using the User-Centered Design (UCD) methodology. The redesign will be evaluated using the System Usability Scale (SUS) method, with a focus on enhancing the quality of user experience. As a result, the overall usability level of the redesigned UI/UX for the SiKeren application, particularly in terms of user acceptance, performance, quality, and potential for user recommendation, has significantly enhanced and surpassed the usability level of the SiKeren application prior to the redesign. The redesigned UI/UX also successfully addresses user needs and preferences, as indicated by positive feedback from respondents during the final iteration interviews.

articleTitle: SQL And NoSQL Object Database Mapping to Support CRUD Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: SQL and NoSQL databases have different data models and query languages, which can pose challenges when mapping between them for CRUD operations. Utilizing object database mapping can help minimize errors when executing database query commands within program code. Manually mapping object models to database tables remains a labor- intensive and error-prone process. This research introduces an approach for building an object mapping framework on SQL and NoSQL databases. We build a framework by carrying out concept mapping, syntax conversion, and developing object database mapping. Object database mapping is developed using chaining method and active record design pattern. The framework was tested using the hospital information system billing module. The results of this research demonstrate that the constructed framework can execute CRUD query commands on three distinct types of databases: MySQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j.

articleTitle: Design and Construction of Vibration Level Monitoring Equipment on Machine Tools Based on the Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: This research aims to design and implement an Internet of Things (IoT) based vibration and rotation sensor system that can be used on machine tools. These sensors are designed to collect vibration and rotation data from machine tools, and then transmit this data to an IoT platform for real-time analysis and monitoring. This research also includes the development of web-based applications to access and analyze sensor data efficiently. The blynk application will display velocity data and graphs from vibrations read by the ADXL335 accelerometer sensor. To identify the level of damage to a tools system in the industrial sector is to analyze the characteristics of vibrations caused by vibrations in general known from the magnitude of the vibration amplitude. The results of the monitoring tool made are tools that work using the concept of the Internet of Thing in monitoring the vibration value of the machine. The results of the test show the value of the vibration speed produced by the instrument is close to the same as the standard vibration meter. The largest error value is 3.03%.

articleTitle: A Survey on the Moving to Green Communications Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Green communications and their techniques have taken a vast amount of consideration with the significant advance of the new world. In the same way with the improvement and the updates in communication techniques, the researchers are concentrating on their work to attain communication as green as promising. In mobile systems the evaluation of 5G and beyond will increase the power consumption that results in excess emission of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Furthermore, with the high demand of wireless traffic in the near future, green radio technology for upcoming wireless networks shall include an end-to- end energy efficiency investigation of mobile terminals, radio access and core networks, and diverse applications. This paper surveys various modes of green communication technologies also some challenges that slow down the development of this technology with demand for green techniques which help to decrease the emission of co2 that is a risk to environmental and human conditions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Tourism Experience Through Video Augmented Reality in Interactive Tourism Media Guide and UX Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Integrating Video Augmented Reality (AR) technology into tourism experiences has revolutionized how travelers engage with cultural heritage and historical sites. This study explores the implementation of Video AR in the context of an Interactive Tourism Media Guide, focusing on Madura dance, a vibrant cultural heritage. By harnessing the power of AR, this research contributes to the preservation of Madura dance and cultural heritage while enhancing tourists' understanding and appreciation. The study delves into the intricacies of the Linear Sequential Model (Waterfall model), ensuring the seamless integration of Madura dance content into the Tourism Media Guide. Furthermore, the study incorporates rigorous user experience (UX) measurement methodologies, providing valuable insights into user satisfaction with Video AR in enriching tourists' interactions with cultural artifacts. Our study not only advances the field of AR-enhanced tourism but also underscores its role in cultural preservation, offering a comprehensive framework for future multimedia-based tourism initiatives. Evaluation based on UX measurement show that our application demonstrates excellent attractiveness, stimulation, and novelty, with above-average perspicuity and good ratings in efficiency and dependability, signifying a compelling design, engaging experience, and overall positive user perception with room for minor enhancements.

articleTitle: Transformer-Based Indonesian Language Model for Emotion Classification and Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: The rapid development of social networks has made much user-generated data accessible for public evaluation. These data can be used for multiple purposes, such as textual analysis of comments and reviews. This article employs a variant of the bidirectional encoder representations from Transformer (BERT) model designed explicitly for Bahasa Indonesia (called IndoBERT model) to enhance the performance of the Indonesian natural language understanding benchmark in tasks, such as sentiment analysis and emotion classification. The two tasks were tested using a hybrid method, combining the IndoBERT model's last hidden layer summation with a neural network model. The performance of the resulting model was assessed using the F1-score metric. The experimental results show that the proposed model attains an accuracy of 0.92 and 0.76 for sentiment analysis and emotion classification, respectively.

articleTitle: Detection of Indonesian Hate Speech on Twitter Using Hybrid CNN-RNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: This research focuses on detecting hate speech on Twitter in Indonesia. The Indonesian government has enacted legislation to address hate speech issues, but certain provisions within the Information and Electronic Transactions Law (UU ITE) require revaluation due to open interpretations. To improve hate speech detection, the researchers employ a combination of deep learning methods, namely CNN and RNN, to analyze offensive language on Indonesian Twitter. The Hybrid CNN-RNN model leverages CNN's ability to extract local features and RNN's capability to model sequential context, ensuring accurate representation and addressing contextual dependencies and variable dimensions. The research aims to enhance the accuracy of hate speech detection by combining the Hybrid CNN-RNN model with Word2Vec word embedding. Previous studies achieved an accuracy of 69.1% using the same method, motivating the need for improvement. The proposed method demonstrates significant progress, with an accuracy of 0.863. The conclusion drawn suggests that the Hybrid CNN- RNN model with Word2Vec embedding is the most effective classification model for detecting hate speech on Indonesian Twitter. Future research recommendations include utilizing larger datasets and implementing enhanced preprocessing techniques to enhance accuracy further.

articleTitle: Automatic Recognition of Madurese Herbal Medicine Rhizome Images Using the Efficientnet Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Recognizing and classifying herbal medicine rhizome images are important in traditional medicine and pharmacology. Our study proposes an automated approach for recognizing Madurese herbal medicine rhizome imagery using the EfficientNet Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The EfficientNet model is known for its optimal balance between accuracy and computational efficiency, making it a suitable choice for image recognition tasks. EfficientNet-B3 is utilized for automated recognition of Madura herbal rhizome image datasets, comprising five types: Temulawak (Curcuma xanthorrhiza), Kencur (Kaempferia galanga), Jahe (Zingiber officinale), Lengkuas (Alpinia galanga), and Kunyit (Curcuma xanthorrhiza) (Curcuma longa). The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, showcasing its potential to assist herbal medicine practitioners and researchers in identifying and cataloging rhizome specimens with high precision. The automated recognition system for Madurese herbal rhizomes revolutionizes the selection process, enabling swift, consistent, and accurate identification during seeding and production. Our proposed system ensures seamless automation, enhancing the efficiency of herbal medicine practices. Moreover, our study will be essential in preserving and promoting traditional herbal medicine knowledge while optimizing production.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Komering Language Translation Engine with Bidirectional RNN Model Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Regional languages represent a significant facet of Indonesian culture, spanning various regions across the archipelago. However, the knowledge of these regional languages is often limited among individuals outside their respective regions. For instance, the Komering Language remains relatively unfamiliar to the inhabitants of the South Sumatra region. The cultural significance of regional languages is at risk of diminishing due to unfamiliarity with the associated words and sentences. Therefore, there is a pressing need to preserve local language cultures to prevent their marginalization. In this research, the authors aim to develop a bidirectional Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model capable of translating Indonesian to the Komering language using machine learning techniques. In the study, a bidirectional model was evaluated using various types of RNN, namely simpleRNN, GRU, and LSTM. The results showed that the bidirectional model with simpleRNN yielded a performance accuracy of 87.12% after 100 epochs.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of CNN Architectures in TCM Hesitant Pulse Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is an alternative medicine practice that originated in China. TCM is based on the concepts of Qi, Yin, and Yang and aims to restore balance in the body. In TCM, the pulse rate is divided into two categories: hesitant and moderate. A hesitant pulse is irregular and has inconsistent intervals between beats, while a moderate pulse falls within the healthy and normal range for adults. Previous research has used deep learning for pulse classification, but none has utilized VGG16, AlexNet, and LeNet. This study aims to improve the accuracy of pulse classification analysis and minimize errors. The research employed a quantitative method and utilized three models. The study used 48 hesitant data and 80 moderate data. The f1-score values for the VGG16 model were 0.0 for hesitant data and 0.76 for moderate data. The AlexNet model achieved f1-scores of 0.90 for hesitant data and 0.94 for moderate data. The LeNet model achieved f1-scores of 0.95 for both hesitant and moderate data. Based on the f1-scores, the LeNet model demonstrated high performance. These results could assist healthcare professionals in improving their detection and analysis of pulse data.

articleTitle: Decision Support System of Part-Time Job Applicants Rank for Information Technology Students Using the MOORA Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: working is one of students' goals when they graduate from college. The difficulty of students competing with senior workers is a significant obstacle. Experience can be gained by working part-time while still studying. The aim of this research is to create a system that bridges students with job providers, especially jobs in the IT field. The advantage of this system is that it is equipped with a ranking list using the MOORA (Multi-Objective Optimization by Ratio) method to support employee recruitment decisions. There are 8 criteria, namely study program, work and internship experience, currently undertaking a thesis, organizational experience, number of expertise certifications, project work ability, research experience and lecturer service. Several of these criteria are grouped according to the priority weight of 20% in C5 (number of expertise certifications) and 20% in C6 (ability to work on projects). The results of the ranking in the recruitment of programmer jobs for lecturer research projects with a quota of 2 people, with an alternative names are A1 and A3 recommended to be accepted for part time work. So this system can be used as decision support for hiring part-time workers. This ranking-based information system is recommended for getting the best employees from among IT students who have met several criteria.

articleTitle: Unmanned Surface Vehicle Docking Using Optical Flow and Global Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: One of the challenging requirements of an Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) is providing a high precision control performance during docking to prevent collisions with the dock walls. While GPS-based navigation is highly effective for guiding USVs from one location to another, it becomes less effective when the USV moves slowly and requires high accuracy. In this paper, we propose a navigation method for USVs using optical flow in conjunction with GPS. GPS remains as the main navigation source as the USV approaches the dock, but during the docking stage, the GPS is disengaged in favor of optical flow as the primary guide. We have successfully implemented this method with an error of 1.3m compared to the GPS-based has an error of 8.3 m. It means that the proposed method improves accuracy up to 7m.

articleTitle: Improved Credit Document Blockchain System Using EduCTX Platform with Decentralized Storage Filecoin
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Academic certificates are pivotal in education and the professional realm as tangible proof of educational completion and job requirements. However, the centralized storage of certificates has weaknesses, increasing the risk of forgery. Blockchain technology has emerged as a solution for micro-credential administration, offering secure, decentralized, and tamper-proof infrastructure. EduCTX is a blockchain-based platform utilizing the IPFS protocol for off-chain storage. Yet, IPFS poses data security challenges. To address this, decentralized storage Filecoin is used. Filecoin provides scalability, flexibility, and data storage security, including economic incentives and cryptographic proof methods. This research explores the need for enhanced storage mechanisms to secure academic credentials. Storage on Filecoin is done using the calibration testnet network and supporting tools like Filecoin Virtual Machine (FVM). The data storage process on Filecoin involves four phases: preparing data for storage deal, deploying a smart contract of storage deal, making a proposal deal, and retrieving data. The data storage agreement process on Filecoin is governed by smart contracts, ensuring its verifiability. Additionally, this research leverages the storage helper tool to facilitate quick data retrieval using the Content Identifier (CID) on the IPFS gateway. This integration ensures the secure and verifiable storage of platform EduCTX credential data.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Meteorological Radar Precipitation Forecast in Banten
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Meteorological radars offer several advantages in representing weather phenomena, including estimating rainfall distribution with high temporal and spatial resolution and representing data in large observations. Automatic Weather Stations (AWS) and Automatic Rain Gauges (ARG) are ground station devices for the measurement of weather parameters, including the intensity of precipitation. Rain gauges suffer from high spatial and temporal variability, especially at low density. The reflectivity is a product of the radar observations. To obtain an estimate of rainfall at the site, it is processed using the Z-R Rosenfeld tropical relationship. Unfortunately, meteorological radars have certain limitations, including beam blocking from the nearest surface, beam attenuation, RF interference, and ground silence or unobserved areas. This study evaluated radar rainfall estimation compared to spatial and temporal rain gauges in Banten. This is especially useful for areas of Banten where there are no rain gauges. Evaluation metrics used in the statistical analyses, namely correlation coefficients, root mean square, and mean absolute error. The results of processing radar imagery for rainfall estimation from ARG rainfall measurements for 1 - 31 December 2022 showed a correlation of 0.80, a mean error of 3.10 and a RMSE of 9.02.

articleTitle: Surveying the Impact of National Identity Card Data Leak to the Security and Serenity in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Data is a crucial component that holds a lot of information. Whether it's information that is public or private. The data is obtained through a long process until in the end the data has been proven valid. Valid data is a high value asset owned by its users. National Identity Card (KTP) is an ID card that is useful for storing valid data on its holder. This card must be owned by everyone who lives in Indonesia. Because this card contains a lot of information on its holder, this card is a high value asset and many are targeted for taking and selling its data by unauthorized parties. As in the case of KTP data leaks that occurred in the RI Ministry of Social database which was carried out by a group of hackers and sold them in online forums. This case occurred for several reasons, including Human error, Malware, insiders with bad intentions, etc. The impact of data leaks can be misused by criminals, especially those related to fraud and social engineering. Data leaks can cause huge losses. Therefore, the purpose of this study was to find out how much people know about the value of KTP and the impact that can be generated if their data is successfully retrieved by someone else. In this study, the author uses survey research whereas we are going to distribute some questionnaires to the public who have KTP according to the topic to be discussed and draw a conclusion out of it. In general, we concluded that most respondents still do not know the impact of leaking KTP data and the level of danger that occurs when it occurs. However, if the government can develop a high security service to secure customer personal data and provide knowledge of the importance of the value in KTP. So, the data can be maintained properly.

articleTitle: Flood Evacuation Route Recommendation Using Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Equipping the society with an evacuation route assistant is important as a preventive action in order to minimize anxiety as well as number of victims when disaster strike. Therefore, research on best route determination to the shelter is a noble task. Evacuation routes mean routes to pass in order to reach the gathering point or shelter safely. This study aims to implement the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm in finding the optimal path to the designated shelter. PSO is a metaheuristic algorithm inspired by the behaviour of flocks of birds or fish to optimize the search for the best route. Taking into account the details of the PSO implementation, including initialization of the random particle position and velocity, selection of the best particle (Pbest) and Global Best (Gbest), and updating the speed and position of the particle using the specified formula. The objective function is recalculated based on the total distance of the particle route as well as the condition weight of the affected areas. The results showed that out of ten experiments with 100 iterations, six valid routes were found with the highest fitness value of 1,935, which indicates that PSO can provide optimal solutions in the context of finding flood evacuation routes.

articleTitle: Analyzing Proxychains Traffic on the Pentest Scenario: Enhancements in Network Forensics through Wireshark
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: This study proposed to enhance network forensics capabilities in detecting and investigating malicious anonymous actions with Wireshark to analyze proxychains traffic that is often carried out by anonymous attackers to hide their identity not revealed. This work can be implemented in cyber investigations and contribute to the advancement of network forensic techniques. Proxychains are tools used by some cybercriminals to redirect network traffic through several proxy servers so that attacks are carried out anonymously and the attacker's IP is one of the greatest challenges to track. This research is carried out and focuses on analyzing the extent to which proxychains can hide the identity of the attacker's IP. This research aims to prove the anonymity of using proxychains and find out the extent of tracing that can be done to track the real attacker's IP conducted by analyzing the PCAP using Wireshark obtained from capturing traffic of information gathering and scanning scenarios on the Pentest phase. The research result shows the method used to gather evidence during forensic investigations of proxy use which show to what extent proxies hide the identity of users.

articleTitle: Comparison of Machine Learning Methods Using Feature Extraction Optimization PCA Method for Identification of Pineapple Maturity Level
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Many features are implemented in computer vision and machine learning applications. Because no one knows how a feature affects the classification results of machine learning methods. Therefore, there is a tendency to increase the number of features. However, features may need to be more relevant than some extracted components. In addition, high feature dimensions can reduce performance in classification. In classifying pineapple maturity levels, 12 characteristics were obtained from extracting color, texture, and color characteristics. Utilizing dimensionality reduction, original data information can be preserved while reducing the number of variables. Feature dimension reduction is done using the feature reduction method and the PCA feature selection method. These important dimensional variables are condensed into fewer without sacrificing information in previous data. The five dominant components have been able to cover 94%• So, for this research, five main components were used, which will then be used in the SVM, KNN, and ANN machine learning models. There is an increase in the percentage of accuracy for each machine-learning method used. The increase in accuracy in the SVM and ANN methods is not very significant, only 1% and 2%. However, an increase in accuracy can be seen in the KNN method of 5%. With an increase in accuracy percentage, the PCA method can produce the best features for understanding the data, reducing processing requirements, and improving prediction performance.

articleTitle: SIGNIN: The Digital Signature and File Verification Management Application Using Secure Rapid Application Development Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: In the current digital era, the security of official documents and digital signatures is becoming increasingly important to prevent the spread of false information or manipulated documents. This research aims to design, develop, and implement a web-based application that we call SIGNIN that addresses the issues of official document validity and digital signature security. The research methodology adopts a Secure RAD (Rapid Application Development) approach involving planning, system design, development, and implementation stages. In the system design stage, the STRIDE concept is used to identify and mitigate security threats in the application. This research shows that the SIGNIN application can provide an effective solution for managing digital signatures, verifying official documents, and enhancing the validity and integrity of records in a digital environment.

articleTitle: Application of Augmented Reality Technology on the Kulinaria Website to Introduce Indonesian Culinary
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Indonesia is a country rich in natural and cultural resources, one of the cultural products is traditional culinary. It has a distinct diversity that reflects the social life, culture, community order, lifestyle, and spirituality of its era. Traditional cuisine has symbolic connotations that communicate significant messages rooted in local wisdom. It is critical for the next generation to preserve this local knowledge since it embodies the energy and wisdom of an entire nation of people. In order to appeal to the younger generation, traditional Indonesian cuisine needs to be modernized and preserved. This study aims to create Kulinaria, an AR marker-based with a website to publish the marker, therefore it can be accessed internationally to introduce Indonesian cuisine. Also, expanding other related studies by developing an interactive AR that responds to markers and tests the effective distance range with distinct color as marker. The AR app was developed in Unity 3D with Vuforia SDK and the website is structured in the form of a landing page with several menus. At the end of the development, application testing was implemented to measure app speed, scalability, and stability to load the 3D objects. The testing results show that in a distance of 20 cm to 80 cm 3D objects can appear. Meanwhile, in the angle testing, a 3D object can appear at an angle of 15° to 45°.

articleTitle: Harnessing the Power of CNN-Transformer Encoders in Stress Speech Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Stress is the physiological response to mental, emotional, or physical stress, which varies between individuals. A survey by Ipsos Global showed that around 30% of respondents identified stress as a significant health issue. Some countries in Southeast Asia, such as Cambodia, have much higher rates of depression than the world average. In Indonesia, the stress rate reached 9.8% in 2018. This research focuses on Speech Stress Recognition (SSR), an automated method that recognizes stress levels through speech characteristic analysis. We use Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) feature extraction and the CNN-Transformer Encoder model. Evaluation results on the SUSAS dataset showed an overall accuracy of 73.76%. When the classification results are viewed by gender, male data appears better at classifying stress levels than female data. To improve performance, we implemented the Voice Activity Detection method, which resulted in an accuracy of 81% for male and 69.23% for female. The findings of this research have potential applications in various fields, including mental health and emotion analysis in human communication.

articleTitle: Big Data Implementation Effect On Financial Decision-Making Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Companies are currently focusing on technological assistance such as Big Data Analysis which can help companies analyze data to get insights and data-based decisions. The aim of this research is to see whether data quality, use of analytical tools, and analytical skills have an influence on the quality of financial decisions taken in Indonesia. This research focused on collecting data from accountants, financial analysts and data practitioners who uses data analysis tools (Microsoft Excel, SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Looker, etc.) in Indonesia. This quantitative research using primary data types and descriptive statistical data analysis is carried out in Smart PLS 4. The findings from this research are that data quality, use of analytical tools, and analytical skills significantly influence the quality of financial decisions.

articleTitle: Optimizing Video Streaming Costs in the Cloud: A CNN Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: As demand for high-quality, on-demand content skyrockets, cost optimization of video streaming in cloud en-vironments has become critical. Addressing this issue, our research introduces Deep Stream Cost (DSC), an innovative deep learning architecture for optimizing cloud-based video streaming costs. DSC employs convolutional neural networks (CNNs), dynamic resource scaling, and task offloading strategies, achieving considerable cost reduction while ensuring optimal video analytics performance. Our results are promising: system efficiency improved by up to 40%, resource usage was curtailed by 30%, and latency was reduced by 25%, all of which are substantial gains over traditional methods. Beyond cost reduction, DSC enhances scalability and availability, thanks to its real-time monitoring, predictive resource provisioning, and cost-awareness feedback loop. DSC's contribution to the development of cost-effective and scalable video delivery systems is highly relevant in today's era of cloud-based services and increasing demand for efficient resource utilization.

articleTitle: A Multivocal Literature Review on Prototype Pollution Vulnerability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: JavaScript is one of the most widely used languages in modern web development. The unique way JavaScript inherits properties and methods between objects leads to a unique vulnerability called prototype pollution. In this paper, we study the problem in a holistic way using a multivocal literature review (MLR). It includes reviews of grey literature (GL) reviews in addition to formal literature to summarize the state of the art and current practice on this topic. We found that the impact of this vulnerability varies due to different implementations of JavaScript, e.g., denial of service (DoS), property injection, session fixation, remote code execution (RCE), privilege escalation, SQL injection, and cross-site scripting (XSS). We also found several methods to detect and mitigate prototype pollution. These include static analysis, dynamic analysis, and hybrid analysis for prototype pollution detection and analysis. Many concerned companies are also successfully mitigating the supply-chain risk of prototype pollution through security crowdsourcing, such as running a bug bounty program, managing an advisories database, and private reporting.

articleTitle: Security Analysis on Websites Belonging to the Health Service Districts in Indonesia Based on the Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 2021
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: In August 2022, the Directorate of Cyber Security Operations, National Cyber and Crypto Agency received the most complaints about cybercrime. Of these complaints, there were more than 100 hacking cases, which were dominated by the local government sector. In the same year, there was a leak of medical sample data belonging to the Central Government of the Republic of Indonesia's Ministry of Health. So, this research aims to analyze the security of a website belonging to the health service of one of the districts in Indonesia. There were eleven vulnerabilities discovered and successfully classified using the OWASP Top 10 2021. Of the eleven vulnerabilities discovered, nine vulnerabilities were successfully exploited by following the WSTG 4.2 guidelines. By using the OWASP Risk Assessment Calculator, four vulnerabilities have a medium severity level and five others have a low severity level. Based on these findings, recommendations for improving each vulnerability are given.

articleTitle: Prediction of TOEFL Completion Exam Using Support Vector Machine (SVM)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: English language skills, indicated by TOEFL, are essential for job administrative selection. Many universities, including the Department of Information Technology Universitas Muhammadiyah Yogyakarta, provide English lectures each semester to prepare students for readiness for TOEFL. Before taking the TOEFL, students must predict whether they will pass the TOEFL or not. Since no such research exists, this study predicted the students' TOEFL completion exam according to their English marks in Semesters 1 - 6. The methods included data collection, preprocessing, and implementing Support Vector Machine (SVM) classification. The SVM is a popular classification method and never be used in this case. The result showed that the SVM could predict students' TOEFL completion with more than 90% accuracy.

articleTitle: Spatial Cluster Analysis of Land Seismicity in the Northem Part of Sumatra Using the K-Medoids Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: In the seismic-prone region of Northern Sumatra, where recent events like the Toba earthquake swarm have reshaped the land's seismic dynamics, understanding the spatial distribution and clustering of earthquakes is paramount for disaster mitigation. This study employs the K-Medoids algorithm to analyze seismic data from January 2019 to 2023, providing crucial insights into seismic event clustering. While K=2 emphasizes depth distinctions, K=3 unravels a nuanced perspective, capturing differences in both depth and geographical location of seismic events. The validity analysis supports these findings, contributing significantly to seismic hazard assessment in North Sumatra. This research underscores the need for ongoing study and heightened preparedness in earthquake-prone regions.

articleTitle: Differentiating Types of Spinal Curvatures Using AlexNet and ResNet-50 Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Scoliosis is a deformity of the spine characterized by a lateral curvature, often in an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S$</tex> or C shape. Scoliosis is usually diagnosed through a physical examination and using a combination of X-rays, CT scans, or MRIs. However, it is possible to misdiagnose scoliosis, especially if the curvature is mild or if the doctor is inexperienced. Therefore, a breakthrough in the early detection of scoliosis is highly required. AI has excellent potential in detecting scoliosis from X-rays. There have been many studies that utilized AI in diagnosing spinal disorders, and most of them obtained excellent results. Hence, it is necessary to compare models and methods to determine the best from them. This study applied two pre-trained models from ImageNet: AlexNet and ResNet-50. This study discovered a slight difference in the average accuracy obtained by both models. The difference was only 1.25% in training and 0.12% in testing. In training and testing measurements, ResNet obtained a perfect score of 100%. However, in terms of time measurement, it required four times more than AlexNet. ResNet-50 took 8 minutes and 58 seconds for training, while AlexNet only took 2 minutes and 4 seconds. These measurements and tests concluded that the two models had excellent performance. Hence, they could help researchers and those who need it in spine image classification.

articleTitle: Kalman Filter and Artificial Neural Network for Real time Sensor Denoising
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Obtaining more accurate and precise information from real-time data requires highly precise sensor readings. The priori and the fundamental step before proceeding with further data analysis and taking conclusions is the denoising of sensor data. Considering this requirement, this article assesses the effectiveness of Kalman filters and feed forward artificial neural networks for the purpose of sensor denoising. To accomplish this objective, we designed an Internet of Things (IoT) device employing a Raspberry Pi 4 and a digital humidity and temperature sensor (DHT 11). After the prototype development, we deployed a discrete time Kalman filter, integrated with ThingSpeak, and then we collected data. The data was filtered using two standard deviations. After that, we performed the outlier's removal and Normality test. Finally, we implemented the artificial neural network to train and test the algorithm, using feed-forward artificial neural network (FF - ANN) with a sequential architecture. For inference, we evaluated the Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Error (MSE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Coefficient of Determination (R2 score), Central Processing Unit Time (CPU.T), Central Processing Unit memory (CPU) and - Standard Deviation (StDev). The results indicated that the Kalman filter is the optimal solution for sensor denoising, reducing data fluctuations, and removing temperature and humidity outliers in real-time for online scenarios. However, it should be noted that FF-ANN exhibits superior MAE, MSE, RMSE, and R2 Score because it was implemented on preprocessed data. The findings showed that the Kalman filter has 3.5 speeder than FF-ANN on convergence time.

articleTitle: Information Technology Innovation Strategies to Fight the Pandemic: Lesson From Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: In this paper we examine information technology innovation strategies during the COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan from various studies. By using systematic literature review, we proposed a research framework consist of Taiwan's IT-based innovation strategies to fight COVID-19. Strategies for digital quarantine management, clinical management systems, prevention and pandemic management. We conclude all IT-based innovation strategies into prioritizing matrix to explore which strategies that have high effort and high benefit. Quarantine management and suspect databases have the highest effort and highest benefit to develop. The outcome of this paper was recommendation that might be use as guideline for other governments to response future pandemic.

articleTitle: Siwaratri Digital Book to Introduce the Ancient Mataram Stories
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: The challenges of increasing reading literacy, book reading habits, and changing children's reading habits provide opportunities to design e-books about Indonesian history. This study aims to create a digital book of concept art based on pipeline concept art in introducing ancient Mataram culture. This study uses a single case in the form of a Siwaratri digital concept art book. The method used in creating this digital concept art book is descriptive narrative, and the exploratory design of concept artworks is guided by the pipeline concept art concept with three stages: design brief, sketching and production. The results of the data analysis obtained are warm and yore as the concept of the work used and by the intended youth readership. This concept is used to guide the Siwaratri digital concept art book. The concept art digital book uses red and yellow domination to represent the concept of warm and yore and e-book output so that the public can easily access it. The presence of the Siwaratri digital concept art book can help introduce Indonesian culture and history, which is digital-based and can be used anytime so that people remember to read books. The Siwaratri concept art digital book design helps readers to understand the ancient Mataram kingdom culture that has long been forgotten.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis on Web Development Programming Language (Javascript, Golang, PHP)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: This paper aims to use an experimental approach to determine the best performing and most stable web programming languages for building a website. Through a comprehensive comparison of different languages such as Golang, JavaScript, and PHP, our research aims to provide valuable insights for developers when it comes to choosing the right web programming language for their next web development project. The objective is to identify the web programming language that offers the best performance and stability in terms of key metrics such as CPU utilization, response time, and scalability. Additionally, the study will also consider the unique set of advantages and disadvantages of each language, to provide a comprehensive assessment of their suitability for different web development projects. Ultimately, the goal of this research is to make it easier for developers to choose the best web programming language for their needs, and to ensure that the resulting website is fast, stable, and easy to maintain. Based on the research and comparison of different languages, it is found that Golang is the best choice for web development projects as it offers the best performance and stability in terms of key metrics such as CPU utilization, response time, and scalability. Additionally, Golang also has a unique set of advantages that make it suitable for different web development projects.

articleTitle: Smart Road Quality Monitoring System Based on Measurement of Vehicle Vibrations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: This study presents a development of a smart road quality monitoring system to support road inspection. Roads are very important infrastructure for ground transportation. The quality of roads has a direct impact on the safety and comfort of road users, including drivers, passengers, loads, and vehicles. Poor quality roads, such as bumpy roads, cracked roads, and potholes, make it difficult to ride and even more leads to accidents. Road quality monitoring must be performed frequently. Unfortunately, this monitoring is time consuming and costly. To simplify the process, a smart road quality monitoring system (SRQMS) is developed in this study. The SRQMS works by measuring vehicle vibration while passing a road. Poor road quality is indicated by high vibration on the vehicle. The SRQMS is made up of a NodeMCU ESP-12 as the microcontroller, an MPU6050 inertia sensor to measure vehicle vibration, a Neo- 6m GPS as the position sensor, and an SD card module to store measurement data. The experimental test of the developed SRQMS was carried out by installing it on a motorcycle and riding along a road target. The result showed that SRQMS was able to identify road quality and location that were presented on a map.

articleTitle: A Survey of the Optimization System Road Damage Detection on CNN Model for Edge Device
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Road damage survey problems are carried out conventionally. It is necessary to develop tools for automatically detecting road damage using technology and artificial intelligence (AI). The difficulty in detecting road damage is that it necessitates the use of an edge device to examine visual data while collecting road defect data in motion. However, quick detection of road damage objects is crucial because of edge devices' constrained processing and storage capacity. Due to the limited computation and storage capabilities of edge sensors, a road damage detection method with high accuracy and low detection time is required. In this research, we present an overview based on sensor cameras using CNN architectures that can be implemented on embedded targets to increase the performance of road damage detection for edge devices. As a result, it is necessary to develop CNN models of one-stage detectors, two-stage detector and a combination of both models to increase accuracy. Additional study is required to improve system performance in order to boost accuracy and inference time by combining tuning hyperparameter, pruning, and quantization methods.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Indonesian Temple Reviews Using Lexicon-Based Features and Stochastic Gradient Descent
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: TripAdvisor is an online platform where people can review tourist destinations. With so many reviews available, assessing public sentiment can be challenging. We conducted sentiment analysis on the review data from Indonesia's five most popular temples: Borobudur, Prambanan, Plaosan, Ijo, and Mendhut. Ratings on Tripadvisor reviews do not determine positive and negative sentences. Therefore, an automated method is necessary. Our research proposed using Lexicon-based and Stochastic Gradient Descent techniques for sentiment analysis. This study uses a lexicon-based because it can determine the weighting for the orientation of positive and negative sentiment words. SGD is used to build classification models because it can solve problems with large and complex datasets. The evaluation results showed that our method can significantly increase the model's performance. The result without a lexicon-based approach has an accuracy value of 70.3% while using a lexicon-based system improves the accuracy to 90.5%.

articleTitle: Adapting the Learning Mechanics and Game Mechanics Model Framework into a Serious Game for External Male Genitalia Education
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: The Serious Game is an emerging medium that is not only for entertainment purposes. It shows remarkable efficacy in education, training, and health. The effectiveness of the Educational Serious Game in health is positive behavior change. The health topic focused in this study is external male genitalia, specifically on male circumcision education. Adapting learning mechanics to sensitive issues like external male genitalia education applied to the game is challenging. The Learning Mechanics and Game Mechanics (LM-GM) model framework is proposed to design a Serious Game for male circumcision education. The LM-GM model can integrate the pedagogical and game design patterns into the game mechanics. Thus, the result is the game features or functionalities linked to the pedagogical aspects. From the LM-GM result analysis, the role-playing game is chosen as the primary genre of the game. Then, It also leads to main features such as an exciting story, dialog system, a turn-based battle interaction, item collection, and an in-game quiz evaluation. Usability testing using the System Usability Scale (SUS) is crucial before exposing a game to its target audience, ensuring that even sensitive content like male circumcision is suitable. In this case, ten young fathers, all circumcised, engaged in a two-day prototype gameplay session, emphasizing the importance of ease of use for prospective users such as adolescents. The SUS result shows a promising score of 80. Based on the SUS score, the LM-GM model has the potential to be used in the game for health education.

articleTitle: Designing an Augmented Reality-Based Serious Game for Rehabilitation of Post-Stroke Patient's Hand Coordination and Motor Skills
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Stroke, a leading global cause of mortality, often results in debilitating motor and coordination impairments. The upper body's slower recovery compared to the lower limbs presents a significant challenge, with approximately 21% of stroke patients unable to fully regain upper limb motor function. As a result, rehabilitating upper limb motor function, particularly hand coordination, is of paramount importance. This paper presents a novel approach to stroke rehabilitation, utilizing Augmented Reality (AR) technology in the form of a game-based intervention. Leveraging advancements in cognitive and motor training, the research focuses on Serious Games (SG), where games serve not only as entertainment but also as educational and therapeutic tools. By employing an AR marker, this system accurately tracks patient movements during rehabilitation. To validate its effectiveness, a comprehensive assessment is conducted using both black-box and white-box testing methods. We also use the Fugl Meyer Assessment for quantifying sensorimotor recovery following strokes. The results demonstrate that the AR-based serious game provides an engaging and effective means of improving hand coordination and motor skills in post-stroke patients. The precise marker recognition, transparent scoring, and efficient completion time recording hold the potential to revolutionize stroke rehabilitation. Future research may explore clinical trials to assess patient outcomes and the game's practicality in a healthcare setting. The development of AR-based rehabilitation games holds promise for post-stroke patients, offering a more comfortable and engaging path to recovery while delivering precise evaluation data to therapists.

articleTitle: The Role of Social Presence, Social Media Attribute and Empathetic Concern to Donation Intention in Indonesia Donation-Based Crowdfunding
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Donation-based crowdfunding platforms offer support to those facing healthcare challenges, but the threat of fraud worries users, potentially discouraging donations. The main objectives are to identify critical social media platform components that affect the performance of donation-based crowdfunding campaigns and to combine cross-platform elements to anticipate and enhance the success of campaigns more precisely. This study employs a quantitative technique and focuses on statistical analysis and empirical data gathered via online questionnaires targeting individuals who are interested in, have used, or have donated to donation-based crowdfunding platforms utilizing a purposive sample of 164 respondents that have been filtered to 144 respondents. The data was collected between May 2023 and June 2023. This study used SmartPLS as the data processing software and the statistical technique SEM was used to process the acquired data. The study uses descriptive statistics to describe the research's findings while highlighting significant patterns and trends in the data. According to the results, Social Presence impacts User Participation, Perceived Trust, Donation Attitude, and Donation Intention.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Attack Pattern of Brute Force Attack on SSH Port
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Cyberattacks are one of the threats in the world of technology. Various kinds of cyberattacks can be a threat to information security. One example of a cyberattack is a brute force attack. The attacker breaks into the system by using various login usernames and passwords. It is necessary to analyze cyberattacks using honeypot to prevent and improve information security from existing cyberattacks. This research aims to analyze the Brute Force Attack Pattern on SSH Port by utilizing a honeypot. This research collected attacks on the SSH port captured by the honeypot server. Visualization logs were created from the honeypot logs to observe the patterns of attacks that targeted the SSH port. We utilized visualization tools like Tableau and Metabase to analyze the attack patterns. The research uses action research methodology to analyze how to prevent attacks. The research results revealed the most exploited usernames and passwords by hackers, analyzed the IP and identified the command patterns that hackers most exploited. We provided recommendations to mitigate the attacks based on these attack patterns.

articleTitle: Spreading the Beauty of Indonesian Culture Through Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Culture has a value as national wealth and an ethical foundation in living a social life. Its uniqueness and diversity make it attractive to local and foreign tourists. With globalisation that contains so many foreign cultures, Indonesian culture starts to fade due to a lack of interest from the young generation. These become a reason to develop an application that can make Indonesian culture appear more interesting, handy, and easy to access. Similar services about culture are generally owned by countries with high cultural diversity such as Japan and India. Their app was developed with various content, language choices, and some kinds of interaction for users. This stuff has not been seen in applications from Indonesia. The application developed has improved on localization of string resources to provide text in English and Indonesian. Another improvement is about giving a chance for users to interact with each other through user posts. The development process begins with problem analysis and designing the system, which is followed by culture data creation and a dashboard to organize the data. After that, the API shows the data of the culture created so it can be used by the application. The process continues by developing an application with MVVM (Model-View-View model) architecture so the project has a good code separation and is easy to maintain. The application is reviewed for accessibility aspects through Google Play pre-launch report and interaction measurements are carried out by using a user engagement scale (UES) short form. To increase visibility, the application provides an online presence on social media. The application can display text information in English or Indonesian, provide a space for users to share their posts or stories and interact with others about culture, and it is developed with general accessibility consideration. With all those things combined, the application is expected to reach a wider target audience.

articleTitle: Development of the Electronic-Based Government System (SPBE) Architecture: Data and Information Domain at Provincial Level Government
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: Electronic-Based Government Systems (SPBE) is fundamentally required to improve the quality of public services by using electronic systems to efficiently and transparently manage bureaucracy. With the overall goal of improving the effectiveness and efficiency of government services, information and technology are essential to support governmental activities including administrative tasks and the provision of public services. In this study, we systematically reviewed and redeveloped the Data and Information Architecture of SPBE in Banten Province, Indonesia which includes Data and Information Architecture Reference and Data and Information Architecture Domain. Our study findings have obtained References and Domains for the SPBE Data and Information Architecture at the third and fourth levels which are the targets for Data and Information Architecture until 2024, as well as the Data and Information Architecture Metadata. This study is potentially beneficial to support the quality improvement of public services in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Deciphering Consumer Skin Care Needs: Analyzing Sentiments and Review Topics of Cetaphil Facial Wash Across Diverse Skin Types
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: This research aims to understand the usage and perception of skincare products, specifically focusing on the facial wash from the Cetaphil brand. A survey revealed that a significant number of women invest in skincare monthly, yet many still lack confidence in their skin's appearance. Despite the plethora of skincare products available, many users still face confusion in choosing the right product, leading to a trial and error approach. This study attempts to map the use of skincare products and identify specific points that can address various skin problems. The research employs sentiment analysis and topic classification to analyze user reviews, aiming to provide insights into user perspectives on skincare products. The sentiment analysis, using the IndoBERT method, achieved an average accuracy of 85% and an F1-score of 93%. Topic classification, on the other hand, achieved an accuracy of 93.49% and an F1-score of 90.28%. The findings suggest that while many users find Cetaphil products beneficial, there are specific skin concerns that the product may not address for everyone. This study provides valuable insights for both consumers and skincare brands, emphasizing the importance of understanding user feedback and tailoring products to meet diverse skincare needs.

articleTitle: Panting Traditional Musical Instruments Through Virtual Reality Environment with Leap Motion Control: Immersive User Experience, Usage Challenges, and Preservation Efforts
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: This research investigates the use of traditional musical instruments based on Virtual Reality (VR) with leap motion control. This technology enables users to virtually interact with Panting instruments and aims to explore immersive user experiences, challenges, and cultural preservation. We collected data through a questionnaire consisting of both open and closed questions, and analyzed the data using descriptive statistics and textual analysis. We can confirm that the proposed modern technology has the potential to promote and preserve traditional Panting musical instruments, especially for the younger generation, but alignment with cultural values and holistic education needs to be considered. In conclusion, VR technology with leap motion control promises to preserve Panting's music, but overcoming technical and cultural challenges is critical to long-term success.

articleTitle: Prototype Evaluation and User Experience Analysis of Automated Distractor Generator for English Test
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: English vocabulary tests are usually conducted in multiple choice form due to the efficiency it offers in scoring. Distractors in multiple choice question gives more impact in question difficulty and extremely difficult to be made. On multiple choice type vocabulary questions, Automated Item Generation (AIG) can be used to generate distractors, or in another term, Automated Distractor Generator (ADG). From the literature that has been studied, no scholarly research has been conducted to assess and analyze the User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX) dimensions of ADG. However, it is crucial to consider the importance of UI and UX to meet user needs, address user issues, and cultivate a satisfying user experience. This research aims to conduct prototype evaluation and user experience analysis of automated distractor generation for English test using UEQ. From the results of the data analysis that has been carried out, it can be concluded that the high fidelity prototype that has been designed is sufficient to meet the user experience. This is proven by the mean value of the six scales which exceeds the value of 0.8. The scale of stimulation has a value of 2.7 which is the highest value than the other 5 scales. Meanwhile, the dependability value of 1.5 is the lowest of all 6 scales. The results of comparing the prototype with the benchmark also show good results. The attractiveness, perspicuity, efficiency, stimulation and novelty scales get excellent status, while the dependability scale gets good status.

articleTitle: Edu Venture Application: Bridging Honorary Teacher with Skill-BasedProject
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Information Technology and Computing (ICITCOM)
abstract: In an era characterized by rapid digital transformation, the education sector stands at the forefront of the quest for tailored and personalized solutions. However, educators, especially honorary teachers, have often been overlooked in the development of mobile apps and platforms. These educators face distinct challenges, such as temporary contracts and limited institutional support. The EduVenture application, developed using the Rapid Application Development (RAD) methodology, addresses these unique needs by offering specialized job opportunities. Employing user-centric design and the innovative “Skills Based Project Recommendations” feature, EduVenture provides a comprehensive platform tailored to educators, redefining their engagement with professional opportunities. A User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ) evaluation underscores the app's excellent attractiveness and stimulation while rating it as good in perspicuity, efficiency, dependability, and novelty. Overall, EduVenture represents a significant step toward reshaping how honorary educators interact with the digital professional world.
